visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Header scrolls away
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The header should stay visible while the page scrolls, but it scrolls out of sight. The sticky rule has no offset to stick to.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
Menu
Long page

solution.code:
Menu
Long page
solution.explanation: position: sticky needs an offset such as top: 0 to know where to stick. Without it the element is positioned as usual and scrolls away with the page.

checks.label: After scrolling the menu is still at the top
